title: Dependency-ordered ideal correction path

phases.name: Facade performance baseline
phases.exit: All public test targets compile and complete within their execution allowances on one commit

phases.name: Geometry contract closure
phases.exit: Validated surface representation-pair matrix is behaviorally complete or honestly partial

phases.name: Topology/Boolean closure
phases.exit: General exact intersection outputs materialize into validated topology

phases.name: Agent edit/query reliability
phases.exit: Certified queries and stable edit identity pass adversarial histories

phases.name: Feature breadth
phases.exit: Critical feature envelopes support general topology rather than fixture classes

phases.name: Interoperability and release proof
phases.exit: External oracles and G0-G7 manifests pass on the release revision

note: Durations are planning estimates, not measured commitments.
